newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI DETAILS TERMS OF MTV MERGER.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI DETAILS TERMS OF MTV MERGER.

text.p: Finnish media group Aamulehti-yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it planned to merge with commercial TV company MTV Oy and Aamulehti shares would be converted into the new company's shares at one-to-one.
Shares in domestic broadcaster MTV would be converted at one to 137.5, it said.
Pending approval by the authorities, the new company would be entered in the trade register at the start of 1998 and seek a bourse listing for its shares, Aamulehti said.
"The boards of Aamulehti-yhtyma and MTV have today signed an agreement to merge," Aamulehti said.
The supervisory boards and annual general meetings of both companies must still approve the plan, it said.
The new company would have two share series, I and II. In both series, each share will have a nominal value of 10.00 markka.
Aamulehti's current series I and series II shares would be exchanged for the new company's I or II shares at a one-to-one conversion ratio.
Holders of MTV shares (nominal value 500.00 markka), would receive 59 series I shares and 78.5 series II shares in the new company for each current share.
The shares representing 20.3 percent of MTV currently owned by Aamulehti would be cancelled, it said.

If all current Aamulehti and MTV shareholders became owners of the new company with stakes corresponding to their present holdings, the new group's biggest owners would be wholesaler Kesko Oy , Swedish media group Marieberg Tidnings Ab , bank Merita Oy , telecoms group Nokia Oy and insurer Pohjola .
